contentItem.title: 平面数：两个整数的乘积
contentItem.englishTitle: And, when two numbers having multiplied one another make some number, the number so produced is called plane, and its sides are the numbers which have multiplied one another.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: And, when two numbers having multiplied one another make some number, the number so produced is called plane, and its sides are the numbers which have multiplied one another.
当两个数字相乘后, 得出一个数字, 如此延长的数字就叫做平面, 其两边是数字, 彼此相乘。
